summary: Frontend-only visual/foundation smoke test after Geist font + unified blue accent design pass. Verified Landing, Login (password flow), Dashboard, Activity nav, Project Memory (/project/9ea97afb-fb31-4b74-bce0-71a284fdc1eb), and Connect Work render dark/cohesive with Geist font loaded. No console/page errors on any tested route. No violet regressions on Landing / Dashboard / Activity / Project pages. Sidebar active pill renders (filled surface + visible blue left bar per screenshots). Composer is dark (rgb(30,30,30)). Only leftover 'violet' detected is the official Figma brand color (rgb(162,89,255)) on the Figma provider tile — sourced from cdn.simpleicons.org/figma; flag for main agent to decide (brand vs. unified-blue policy).

issues: Figma provider tile uses Figma's brand violet rgb(162,89,255) via cdn.simpleicons.org/figma icon + matching span background. Every other provider tile is neutral/blue. If unified-blue accent must be enforced on ALL provider tiles per the STEP 1 spec, recolor the Figma icon/tile to blue-neutral. Otherwise document as intentional brand exception.

Two 404s from cdn.simpleicons.org: /slack and /adobe (external CDN — icon endpoints not found). Doesn't crash UI (Slack shows a fallback purple hash icon) but is a noisy network warning. Consider self-hosting provider SVGs or switching to a stable icon set.

action_items: Decide policy on Figma provider tile violet on /app/connect — brand-exception or recolor to unified blue.
Fix broken external icon requests on /app/connect: cdn.simpleicons.org/slack and /adobe return 404 (self-host or replace).
critical_code_review_comments: Geist font loaded correctly on all tested routes (document.fonts includes Geist + Geist Mono; body font resolves to 'Geist, ...').
No console errors on Landing / Dashboard / /app/activity / Project Memory.
Dashboard composer, sidebar, stat cards, and project cards all render dark and cohesive; no white/light panels observed.
Login inputs are type='text' (email) + type='password' — placeholder 'you@studio.com' and data-testid 'login-email-input' / 'login-password-input' work; prefer testid selectors in future scripts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: goto /login → click text 'I have a password' → fill '[data-testid=login-email-input]' and '[data-testid=login-password-input]' → click 'Sign in' → waits ~3.5s for page-loader. Do NOT use input[type=email] (email field is type=text). Dashboard active nav pill's left blue bar is NOT rendered via ::before (content:none) — it uses a child element or box-shadow; visual confirmed in screenshots. Only violet leftover found system-wide is Figma brand color on connect-app-figma tile.
